EmailTemplate.description: Default template for the Registrar - Residency Classification Approvals
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Registrar Residency Classification Approved
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Your request to be classified as an Arizona resident for tuition purposes for the << TERM >> has been approved. Your classification has been changed to resident and you will see this reflected on your My ASU page at https://my.asu.edu.
Questions regarding your tuition balance and/or refunds should be directed to Student Business Services at 480-965-6341.
Changes to residency can affect financial aid and the amount of assistance you receive may decrease as a result of this change. Please contact Financial Aid and Scholarship Services at 480-965-3355 if you have questions about your award(s). If your financial aid is reduced, you will notified by email and instructed to view your My ASU page for details https://my.asu.edu.
The Residency Classification Office can be reached via email at residencydocs@asu.edu or by calling 480-965-7712.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Residency Classification University Registrar Services Arizona State University Phone: (480) 965-7712 www.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
